# Type scale (`type-scale`)

The text styles, jumbo to caption, at this device class.

Group: Foundations. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/foundations';` (or `style.css`).

## Web example

```ts
import { resolveTokens, themeById } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/tokens';

// In CSS the sizes are the --mh-text-* variables, which follow the device class.
const title = document.createElement('h2');
title.textContent = 'Kitchen';
title.style.fontSize = 'var(--mh-text-headline)';

// In code, resolve the theme for a device class and read its type scale.
const tokens = resolveTokens(themeById('midnight')!, 'tablet');
const size = tokens.type.display;

const reading = document.createElement('canvas');
reading.width = 200;
reading.height = size * 1.4;
const ctx = reading.getContext('2d')!;
ctx.font = `${size}px ${tokens.typeface.sans}`;
ctx.fillStyle = tokens.theme.palette.heading;
ctx.fillText('19.5°', 0, size);

document.body.append(title, reading);
```

## React API

`ThemeProvider` (types in `dist/react/theme.d.ts`): Applies a theme (as `applyTheme` does) and provides its resolved tokens to `useTokens()`.

```ts
export function ThemeProvider({ theme, deviceClass, character, accent, scope = 'document', className, children }: ThemeProviderProps);

export interface ThemeProviderProps {
  /** A built-in theme id or a theme object. */
  theme: Theme | string;
  deviceClass?: DeviceClass;
  character?: Partial<Character>;
  accent?: AccentName | 'default';
  /** Apply to `<html>` (default) or to a wrapping `<div>` (several themes on one page). */
  scope?: 'document' | 'local';
  className?: string;
  children?: ReactNode;
}
```

`useTokens` (types in `dist/react/theme.d.ts`): The resolved tokens of the nearest `ThemeProvider` (for values CSS can't reach: canvas drawing, charts).

```ts
export function useTokens(): Tokens;
```

## React example

```tsx
import { ThemeProvider, useTokens } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

function Reading() {
  // For SVG text, read the size from the type scale of the current device class.
  const { type, typeface, theme } = useTokens();
  return (
    <svg width={200} height={type.display * 1.4} role="img" aria-label="19.5 degrees">
      <text y={type.display} fontSize={type.display} fontFamily={typeface.sans} fill={theme.palette.heading}>
        19.5°
      </text>
    </svg>
  );
}

export function TypeScaleExample() {
  return (
    <ThemeProvider theme="midnight" deviceClass="tablet">
      {/* In CSS the sizes are the --mh-text-* variables. */}
      <h2 style={{ fontSize: 'var(--mh-text-headline)' }}>Kitchen</h2>
      <Reading />
    </ThemeProvider>
  );
}
```
